lessen.tekst: Against Behemoths without a two-plus armour save, consider a shooting King or Thane with Master Rune of Slaying, Rune of Accuracy and Rune of Rapid Fire. He suggests this particularly against lightly armoured targets such as Ghorgons and Gigantic Spawn of Chaos.
lessen.waarom: He says the build produces two D3-damage shots, hitting and wounding Behemoths on threes. He also likes the potential surprise damage from Stand and Shoot.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says the low AP makes it struggle against dragons with a two-plus armour save.

bronnen.citaat: I would definitely suggest taking the Rune of accuracy and the Rune of Rapid Fire

extraCitaten.citaat: it does struggle to deal with dragons that are on a two- up save

lessen.titel: Bait dragons with a frontline Toughness 10 Anvil
lessen.tekst: Consider deploying an Anvil of Doom at the front of your lines with Rune of Adamant. Offer it as a tempting alternative to your high-combat-resolution blocks, then exploit the time the dragon spends fighting it.
lessen.waarom: He says dragons wound the Toughness 10 Anvil on sixes and are unlikely to kill it quickly. Pinning the dragon can let the rest of the army attack elsewhere or prepare supporting charges.

bronnen.citaat: give it the Rune of adamant so suddenly it's toughness 10

extraCitaten.citaat: then suddenly they're stuck there

lessen.titel: Consider a protected Royal Clans King with Rune of Smiting
lessen.tekst: For Royal Clans, he likes a King with Master Rune of Gromril, Rune of Preservation and Master Rune of Smiting. Support him with the unit banner providing a five-plus ward save so he can survive and strike back at a dragon.
lessen.waarom: He says the protection helps the King survive a round, while D6 damage can punish failed dragon saves heavily.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He notes that the attacks are only AP2 before Armour Bane, leaving many dragons a four-plus armour save.

bronnen.citaat: the master Rune of gromril the Rune of preservation and master Rune of smiting

extraCitaten.citaat: do D6 damage

lessen.titel: Usually release Fanatics on your opponent's turn
lessen.tekst: Usually release Fanatics on your opponent's turn, especially when defending. Hold them back to put them in a charger's path, then move them through that unit again in the opponent's random movement phase.
lessen.waarom: He says this lets the Night Goblins move closer beforehand, reduces the risk of blocking your own movement and charges, and allows two passes through an enemy charger.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes releasing Fanatics into the path of Grail Knights charging Night Goblins, then moving them back through the Knights after contact, or towards another target if the Knights are already dead.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He notes that later random movement can still obstruct your own units.

bronnen.citaat: you probably want to release your opponent's turn

extraCitaten.citaat: it allows you to double tip on your opponent's charging unit

lessen.titel: Put attacking Fanatic carriers on the front line
lessen.tekst: When you are the aggressor, put your Fanatic-carrying units on the front line and advance them as quickly as possible.
lessen.waarom: He says reaching the enemy matters more than anything else in this role.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says positioning still matters, and defensive Fanatic use demands more careful placement.

bronnen.citaat: put them on the front line and go forwards as fast as possible

lessen.titel: Guard artillery flanks with Fanatics
lessen.tekst: In a defensive army, put a small Night Goblin unit with Fanatics on a flank to protect your war machines. Release one or two against approaching skirmishers or Eagles rather than committing all the Fanatics together.
lessen.waarom: He finds units coming around the army's edges difficult to handle and says one or two Fanatics can deal with these flank hunters quite handily.
lessen.voorbeeld: He also describes using the flank unit against an opponent trying to overwhelm that flank with Grail Knights or Blood Knights.

bronnen.citaat: if I want to protect those I like having fanatics on a flank

extraCitaten.citaat: one or two Fanatics can deal with like skirmishes or Eagles

lessen.titel: Use Itchy Nuisance to make Fanatics threaten dragons
lessen.tekst: Use Itchy Nuisance to reduce a dragon's Toughness before hitting it with Fanatics. He considers this the main way to make Fanatics really frighten a dragon, particularly with several nearby Fanatic-carrying units.
lessen.waarom: He says Strength 5 is not usually frightening into Toughness 6, but reducing the dragon to Toughness 3, 4 or even 5 makes the Fanatic hits more threatening.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He notes that the spell's 15-inch range requires the caster to be further forward and centrally positioned; reducing the dragon only to Toughness 5 is still not ideal.

bronnen.citaat: make your Fanatics really scare a dragon

extraCitaten.citaat: if you can drop that Dragon to toughness three

lessen.titel: Position Fanatic support casters two turns ahead
lessen.tekst: Work backwards from where the opponent wants to charge two turns from now, and position your supporting casters to cover the places their units will move into to threaten you. Combine that coverage with the threat of Fanatics to control space.
lessen.waarom: He says the combined threats can create space in the middle and deter the opponent from taking otherwise favourable positions, which can be stronger than actually using the Fanatics.

bronnen.citaat: their next turn but the turn after so that you can work backwards

extraCitaten.citaat: the threat of Fanatics and the threat of the casters

lessen.titel: Use marching column for Fanatic delivery only when safe
lessen.tekst: Consider marching column to move Night Goblin carriers into positions for Fanatics to pass through multiple enemy units. Before doing so, make sure enemy shooting will not expose the unit to panic checks.
lessen.waarom: He says Night Goblins rely on Horde and Warband for reasonable Leadership, and a flank unit may also be outside the general's range. Fleeing carries the Fanatics away from where they need to be.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He calls this risky when incidental shooting can thin the unit enough to cause panic, especially on a flank outside the general's Leadership range.

bronnen.citaat: if you are in marching column make sure that you're not at risk

extraCitaten.citaat: goblins flee easily

lessen.titel: Use Arcane Urgency for unexpected Fanatic launch angles
lessen.tekst: Consider Arcane Urgency to give a Night Goblin carrier an extra move before releasing its Fanatics. He particularly values sending a cheap, small unit up the board to find launch angles the opponent has not protected.
lessen.waarom: He says the additional movement can reach angles the opponent did not anticipate.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes moving a Close Order unit eight inches, using Arcane Urgency for another eight, and placing a Fanatic three inches further forward for nineteen inches of positional movement.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He warns that building the entire turn around this can be ruinous if the spell is dispelled, fails or miscasts.

bronnen.citaat: get 19 in of positional movement out of your Fanatics

extraCitaten.citaat: you can get angles that your opponent maybe didn't see

lessen.titel: Measure Pathways corner to corner for longer Fanatic launches
lessen.tekst: With Travel Mystical Pathways, exploit the speaker's distinction between within twelve inches and wholly within twelve inches. Measure from the carrier unit's corner nearest the destination and put its far corner just within twelve inches, then choose a facing that gives the Fanatics a useful launch angle.
lessen.waarom: He says stretching the unit's placement this way provides considerable extra reach, while changing its facing without spending movement on wheeling makes it harder for the opponent to respond.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes a four-by-five Night Goblin unit producing a Fanatic placement about eighteen or nineteen inches from its starting position.
lessen.wanneerNiet: The unit must not already have moved.

bronnen.citaat: it's within it's not wholly within

extraCitaten.citaat: corner just within 12 in

lessen.titel: Use two Fanatics to remove each other after damaging passes
lessen.tekst: If a valuable pass through several enemy units would leave two Fanatics dangerously close to your own units or blocking charges, arrange for both to emerge in the same position. He suggests letting the second pass through the first so they inflict automatic hits on each other and are likely to die.
lessen.waarom: He says this can prevent the Fanatics from damaging your own units on the next turn after they have already hurt the enemy line.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says this works for two Fanatics rather than a third, and their deaths are not guaranteed. He normally prefers positions that let Fanatics keep hitting the opponent over several turns.

bronnen.citaat: use them to kill each other and not risk taking hits on the next turn

extraCitaten.citaat: have them come out in the same position

lessen.titel: Consider Furious Charge infantry for pushing enemies off objectives
lessen.tekst: Consider using infantry with Furious Charge aggressively to push enemy infantry off an objective, including in a late-game fight when other support is gone. He thinks these units now have a fighting chance rather than having to wait to receive a charge.
lessen.waarom: He explains that the extra attack compensates for losing the second rank's attacks when charging, making the previously unfavourable infantry charge more viable.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes a late-game standoff a few inches from an objective, with cavalry finished and artillery destroyed or lacking targets, leaving infantry to win the combat and push the defender back.

bronnen.citaat: a fighting chance of being able to deliver.

extraCitaten.citaat: I think you can actually now start to have quite a bit of fun

lessen.titel: Consider charging with hand-weapon-and-shield Orcs
lessen.tekst: Consider using Orc Mob with hand weapons and shields to charge rather than waiting to be charged. He thinks Furious Charge makes this useful alongside Choppas while retaining their Parry protection.
lessen.waarom: He says the front rank's extra attacks replace the second rank's attacks, while Choppas adds wound rerolls of natural ones and extra armour piercing. He also notes that the unit retains a four-plus armour save against attacks coming back.

bronnen.citaat: Furious charge plus one attack.

extraCitaten.citaat: They're not sacrificing their parisave.
That seems pretty useful.

lessen.titel: Reconsider halberds for charging Chaos Warriors
lessen.tekst: Consider halberds on Chaos Warriors intended to charge enemy infantry. He thinks Furious Charge makes the offensive upgrade more attractive than it was when the unit mainly received charges.
lessen.waarom: He says charging preserves their attack output despite losing the second fighting rank and will almost certainly let them strike before the opponent. He highlights the extra Strength, AP2 and Armour Bane, with the new six-plus ward save potentially helping against surviving attacks.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says this sacrifices some resilience. Against regular Tomb Kings infantry deployed very wide and deep, he doubts they will kill enough models to prevent many attacks coming back.

bronnen.citaat: Might it be a chance for them to think about some of the upgrades?

extraCitaten.citaat: a lot of weapons that you would upgrade infantry with such as halbirds
This moves the needle towards doing a bit more damage.

lessen.titel: Consider using Slayers aggressively with Furious Charge
lessen.tekst: Consider charging with Slayers rather than using them defensively. He thinks Furious Charge particularly benefits their aggressive role.
lessen.waarom: He says charging probably lets them strike first, while the extra attack compensates for losing the second rank's attacks. If the enemy strikes back, he notes that the Slayers can still inflict damage on death.

bronnen.citaat: because they're now charging. They're probably going first.

extraCitaten.citaat: they're going to start doing some damage on death anyway.

lessen.titel: Bring flankers into stalled Boar Boy fights
lessen.tekst: In Nomadic Waaagh, use flanking units to rescue Boar Boyz that have lost their initial momentum. Bring another unit into the combat rather than leaving the Boar Boyz to grind alone.
lessen.waarom: He says the Boar Boyz lose their charge-related damage bonuses after the first round, and will eventually lose a prolonged grind without help.

bronnen.citaat: you need other units to enter the combat

extraCitaten.citaat: if you just try and grind out a combat over a number of turns

lessen.titel: Consider a third crew member and Frenzy for Orc chariots
lessen.tekst: He recommends the third crew member and Frenzy upgrades for an Orc Boar Chariot. He considers the resulting 101-point build worthwhile.
lessen.waarom: He values getting six Strength four, AP1 attacks on the charge in addition to the impact hits.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He warns that Frenzy sacrifices control, so he would not necessarily make every chariot frenzied.

bronnen.citaat: I think the third crew and the frenzy are worth it.

lessen.titel: Prefer regular Orc chariots for their charge rerolls
lessen.tekst: For his Nomadic Waaagh, he prefers regular Orc Boar Chariots over Black Orc Boar Chariots because Warband lets them reroll charges. He prioritises reaching combat with the impact hits over paying for the Black Orc version's advantages.
lessen.waarom: In his experience, Give Ground and Fall Back in Good Order change the location of the Boar Boyz' combat before a supporting chariot can join it. He often ends up attempting 12- or 13-inch charges, where he particularly values the reroll.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He still considers Black Orc Boar Chariots good and worth their points. Under the combined-arms limit he describes, he would take one if he already had three regular Orc Boar Chariots and wanted a fourth chariot.

bronnen.citaat: the regular chariot is the way to go for me.

extraCitaten.citaat: not having the Warband means you can't reroll the charge roll.

lessen.titel: Prefer great weapons on Black Orc chariot crew
lessen.tekst: He would probably choose great weapons for the crew of a Black Orc Boar Chariot. In a Nomadic Waaagh list, use them to supply high-Strength attacks that the other units may lack.
lessen.waarom: He says the great weapons provide four Strength six attacks on the charge, filling a possible gap left by the Goblin units and Boar Boyz.

bronnen.citaat: And you probably go great weapons, right?

lessen.titel: Consider a Giant to finish stalled Boar Boy fights
lessen.tekst: Consider a Giant as a Nomadic Waaagh flanking unit that joins combat when the Boar Boyz fail to break through. He considers it a good choice and probably worth 200 points.
lessen.waarom: Drawing on other players' experience rather than his own, he values its control and Unbreakable status, high-Strength damage and stomps. He thinks Movement six is enough to keep up with the mounted army.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He warns that its lack of armour makes it vulnerable to shooting, and expects it to die quite often, giving away 200 points.

bronnen.citaat: you can't say to anyone it's a bad choice to take a giant.

extraCitaten.citaat: and that's going to be the giant

lessen.titel: Use early threats to draw shooting away from the Giant
lessen.tekst: He thinks a Giant pairs well with an aggressively played Warboss on Wyvern with better saves. Push early threats towards the enemy so the Giant has a chance to approach without being their shooting priority.
lessen.waarom: He thinks approaching Boar Boyz and the Warboss may take the brunt of enemy fire, giving the Giant a couple of turns to reach combat before being shot to death.

bronnen.citaat: it goes well if you've got say a war boss on Wyven

extraCitaten.citaat: taking the um the brunt of the enemy fire

lessen.titel: Use Vanguard and marching column to flank with Boar Boyz
lessen.tekst: Use a small, character-free Boar Boy unit with Vanguard in marching column to exploit a deployment gap down a flank. After its Vanguard move, march around or behind the enemy on turn one, then reform for a later charge.
lessen.waarom: He says the unit can Vanguard seven inches and move 21 inches on turn one. Getting behind the enemy makes them choose between turning to face the Boar Boyz and continuing forward.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says the Vanguard upgrade does not allow characters in the unit to Vanguard. The unit cannot charge in marching column and needs a turn to reform; after Vanguard it also cannot charge on turn one.

bronnen.citaat: vanguards seven and then on turn one you can move 21 in

extraCitaten.citaat: If you see a gap on the side
the vanguarding Boar Boyz will be a smaller unit of Boar Boyz with no characters

lessen.titel: Consider Frenzy for vanguarding Boar Boy flankers
lessen.tekst: Consider Frenzy on the small Boar Boy unit vanguarding up a flank, particularly if Big 'Uns and the Banner of Butchery are already used on the battleline units. Manoeuvre it to face the battlefield and threaten a turn-two charge.
lessen.waarom: He values the additional Strength four attacks on the charge and says the enemy cannot ignore a unit such as seven Boar Boyz each delivering three attacks.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He reminds players that a unit which has used Vanguard cannot charge on turn one.

bronnen.citaat: just to put frenzy on the Boar Boyz.

extraCitaten.citaat: you put frenzy on there for just more strength four attacks on the charge.

lessen.titel: Use late ambushers to contest or capture table quarters
lessen.tekst: A small, cheap ambushing unit can still contribute if it arrives late. Use it to contest or capture a table quarter the opponent thought was safe and gain Domination points.

bronnen.citaat: can just move on and start taking domination points

extraCitaten.citaat: table quarter which your opponent thought was safe.

lessen.titel: Think carefully before ambushing Minotaurs
lessen.tekst: Think carefully before putting a Minotaur Herd into ambush. It needs to reach a worthwhile close combat to contribute, and a prepared opponent can deny it useful targets.
lessen.waarom: He found that screening out useful ambush positions left the Minotaurs achieving little, while their absence early on let him concentrate his shooting on other targets.
lessen.voorbeeld: In his game, the scenario barred entry from the short board edges, allowing him to screen out useful targets. The three Minotaurs killed roughly 60 points of archers before taking heavy artillery fire and routing near the end.

bronnen.citaat: think very closely about whether you're going to use them in ambush or not.

extraCitaten.citaat: Didn't really achieve anything.

lessen.titel: Bring Marauder Horsemen on safely before attacking the backline
lessen.tekst: Use Marauder Horsemen's speed to enter from ambush out of harm's way. On the following turn, use their charge capabilities to attack the enemy backline.
lessen.waarom: He says their speed lets them enter safely and still reach combat afterwards. In his view, enemy units worth fighting are likely to be occupied in the front line, making cavalry in the backline a problem.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He considers their shooting less useful than Road Wardens' firearms.

bronnen.citaat: they're quick enough that you can bring them in out of harm's way.

extraCitaten.citaat: into combat and start bashing up the backline.

lessen.titel: Be cautious with ambushers that cannot survive before fighting
lessen.tekst: Be cautious about relying on ambushers that must reach close combat to contribute but cannot withstand a turn after arriving.
lessen.waarom: He expects separate arrival rolls to bring units on piecemeal, making it easier for an opponent with a backline defender to deal with them one at a time.

bronnen.citaat: relying on something that does need to get into close combat

extraCitaten.citaat: your opponent, if they've got something left back to deal with them

lessen.titel: Prefer keeping Sky Lanterns on the board from turn one
lessen.tekst: He doubts that buying Ambush for Sky Lanterns is worthwhile. Prefer having them on the board consistently so their bombs and small arms can attack core units from turn one.
lessen.waarom: He says they already have Scouts, rules preventing them being pinned in combat, good small-arms fire and potentially a high wound count, making them difficult to deal with already.

bronnen.citaat: I don't think it probably is because they've already got scout.

extraCitaten.citaat: you probably want them on the board consistently

lessen.titel: Use light cavalry to clear enemy redirectors
lessen.tekst: Use light cavalry to remove enemy chaff that would otherwise redirect your main combat units.
lessen.waarom: He says preventing enemy chaff from acting as effective redirectors lets your main combat units do their job.

bronnen.citaat: We've also got a role of chaff clearance.
they want to get into enemy chaf units

extraCitaten.citaat: try and clear them off the board allowing you more freedom to act

lessen.titel: Support combats with rank-denying light cavalry flank charges
lessen.tekst: Get light cavalry around an enemy's side and make a supporting flank charge when the cavalry has enough Unit Strength to remove the enemy's rank bonus.
lessen.waarom: He says losing two or three points of combat resolution can swing the combat in your favour.

bronnen.citaat: can get a supporting charge in that just takes away the rank bonus

lessen.titel: Charge vulnerable lone wizards with light cavalry
lessen.tekst: Look for opportunities to charge vulnerable lone wizards with light cavalry.
lessen.waarom: He says lone wizards are common and rely on staying close to friendly units for safety; poorly used ones can be picked out by charging light cavalry.

bronnen.citaat: they are vulnerable to being picked out by charging like cavalry

lessen.titel: Send light cavalry to finish fleeing units
lessen.tekst: Use a small light cavalry unit to finish fleeing enemies rather than sending a large combat unit chasing them around the battlefield.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He thinks these opportunities are less common because of Fall Back in Good Order.

bronnen.citaat: finish them off with a small unit of light cavalry

lessen.titel: Let infantry replace light cavalry on early objectives
lessen.tekst: Use a core light cavalry unit of Unit Strength 10 to grab early objective points, then let infantry take over holding the position.
lessen.waarom: He warns that taking and holding objectives ties up light cavalry's mobility.

bronnen.citaat: go up, grab those early points. The infantry then comes and takes over.

lessen.titel: Preserve light cavalry for late Domination scoring
lessen.tekst: If you want light cavalry to claim table quarters in Domination, consider keeping them safe until they can use their mobility at the end of the game.
lessen.waarom: He says their mobility lets them slip into table quarters and add to your score.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He cautions that they may otherwise be too weak to survive for this role.

bronnen.citaat: keeping those light cavalry safe from harm.

extraCitaten.citaat: at the end of the game, having that mobility to slip into table quarters

lessen.titel: Vanguard Outriders into a static firing position
lessen.tekst: When Outriders have Ponderous on their weapons, use Vanguard to position them and then stay reasonably static, firing at suitable targets.
lessen.waarom: He wants to maximise their firepower by avoiding the effects of Ponderous.
lessen.wanneerNiet: If threatened, he says Outriders can redeploy at the cost of reduced fire output.

bronnen.citaat: you want to be vanguarding and staying reasonably static
use their Vanguard rule to step into range at the start of a game

extraCitaten.citaat: sit statically for as long as possible blazing away with their repeater rifles

lessen.titel: Consider pistol-armed Road Wardens for controllable light cavalry
lessen.tekst: If you can afford the more expensive option, consider Empire Road Wardens with a brace of pistols instead of Pistoliers.
lessen.waarom: He views them as effectively Pistoliers without Impetuous, which he still considers a weakness even after the FAQ.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He notes that five with pistols and Ambush, without a champion, reach 100 points.

bronnen.citaat: these are effectively pistolers without the impetuous special rule.

extraCitaten.citaat: give them a brace of pistols

lessen.titel: Use Outriders to reduce infantry numbers
lessen.tekst: Use Outriders to whittle down enemy infantry when you are concerned about being outnumbered.
lessen.waarom: He says their repeater handguns can chew up light infantry and knock models off effectively.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says moving them can mean sacrificing some shooting effectiveness.

bronnen.citaat: whittle down units of infantry if you're worried about outnumber and stuff like that.

lessen.titel: Place Bolt Throwers on extreme flanks to rake cavalry
lessen.tekst: Deploy Bolt Throwers on extreme flanks to shoot along the side of enemy cavalry formations. He considers this their best use when there are few deeply ranked units to target.
lessen.waarom: He says a shot down the side can hit each model along its path, although its Strength decreases as it passes through models.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He warns that the Dwarf crew's Ballistic Skill means they are usually hitting on fives.

bronnen.citaat: the best way to do this is position the buol thrower at an extreme flank

extraCitaten.citaat: hit every model on the way through

lessen.titel: Use cheap Bolt Throwers as sacrificial flank distractions
lessen.tekst: Use cheap Bolt Throwers on extreme flanks as expendable distractions. Make the opponent send units away from your main line to deal with them.
lessen.waarom: He says their low cost makes them affordable to lose, while leaving them alone risks taking wounds from their shooting.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He would try to keep them safe if he had spent many extra points on runes.

bronnen.citaat: sacrificial units on the extreme flanks

extraCitaten.citaat: the opponent's going to have to send units over there

lessen.titel: Choose Rune of Skewering for a Bolt Thrower
lessen.tekst: If upgrading a Bolt Thrower with a rune, he recommends Rune of Skewering.
lessen.waarom: He values its extra Strength and the removal of armour saves, including two-plus saves.

bronnen.citaat: the Rune that I would say to go for is the Rune of skewering

extraCitaten.citaat: this Rune adds plus one strength and also means that there's no armor saves allowed

lessen.titel: Use hills to open artillery lines of sight
lessen.tekst: Place artillery such as cannons and Organ Guns on a hill when one is available to improve their choice of visible targets.
lessen.waarom: He says the elevated position frees their line of sight and lets them target more of the board.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He notes that woods and other hills can still obscure targets from a cannon on a hill.

bronnen.citaat: in deployment you're going to be looking at putting these on Hills

extraCitaten.citaat: this is really good because it frees up what they can see

lessen.titel: Separate artillery to prevent chained overruns
lessen.tekst: Keep war machines apart or stagger them so that an enemy cannot destroy one and overrun straight into the next.
lessen.waarom: He warns that adjacent war machines can let an attacker kill one and immediately reach another with its overrun.

bronnen.citaat: you want to make sure that these are separated and not just put straight together

extraCitaten.citaat: the enemy units won't just be able to overrun straight through them

lessen.titel: Consider grapeshot against small units approaching your cannon
lessen.tekst: When a small enemy unit closes on your cannon and a cannonball would do little, consider switching to grapeshot within its 12-inch range.
lessen.waarom: He says its automatic Strength 4, AP1 hits could make the difference between killing the approaching unit and losing the cannon.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes five Goblin Wolf Riders in a single rank close to the cannon: a cannonball could kill only one, so he would use grapeshot to try to remove the harassing unit.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He warns that the shot count involves considerable luck and can misfire.

bronnen.citaat: your Cannonball isn't going to do too much you can elect to use grape shot
use your grape shot when the cannon starts getting threatened up close and personal

extraCitaten.citaat: blow away that small harassing unit

lessen.titel: Consider Rune of Forging for an artillery misfire reroll
lessen.tekst: Consider Rune of Forging on a cannon or Grudge Thrower to reroll a misfire, particularly without a nearby Engineer.
lessen.waarom: He recommends it as a way to improve artillery reliability when an Engineer is not available to provide the reroll.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says the rune can only be used once.

bronnen.citaat: for the cannon and The Grudge thrower I would suggest Runes of forging

extraCitaten.citaat: if you don't have an engineer nearby

lessen.titel: Consider Rune of Reloading to keep artillery firing
lessen.tekst: Consider Rune of Reloading on a cannon or Grudge Thrower to keep it firing after a non-destructive misfire.
lessen.waarom: He says a misfire-table result other than a one still allows the machine to fire next turn with this rune.

bronnen.citaat: also the Rune of reloading it just keeps them firing more

extraCitaten.citaat: you can still fire the next turn which is really handy

lessen.titel: Take Grudge Throwers to pressure enemies out of hiding
lessen.tekst: He recommends trying at least one Grudge Thrower, and preferably two if they fit. Use their early shooting pressure to make enemies approach rather than remain hidden.
lessen.waarom: He finds that pressure in turns one and two stops enemies simply hiding behind buildings and helps a relatively static Dwarf army control the game's momentum.

bronnen.citaat: I always try and take at least one of these and probably two

extraCitaten.citaat: the pressure that they can put on the enemy in turns one and turns two
they have to come near you and they can't just hide behind buildings

lessen.titel: Bombard hidden survivors to collect their points
lessen.tekst: Use a Grudge Thrower's bombardment to shoot targets hiding behind units or terrain. He highlights hidden characters and small units that have spent several turns running away as worthwhile opportunities.
lessen.waarom: He values being able to reach these targets without line of sight, including to collect a fleeing unit's points late in the game.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He warns that bombardment still scatters on a hit result, with the crew's Ballistic Skill reducing that scatter.

bronnen.citaat: this is really good for sniping out enemy characters

extraCitaten.citaat: steal their points at the end of the game

lessen.titel: Hide Grudge Throwers and fire by bombardment
lessen.tekst: Deploy Grudge Throwers behind hills, woods or buildings when you want to keep enemies from reaching them, then fire using bombardment.
lessen.waarom: He recommends using their ability to bombard without line of sight to keep them hidden while still shooting.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He allows a position with line of sight when the enemy cannot reach them and has no Scouts.

bronnen.citaat: you could put these behind Hills or Behind Woods or even behind buildings

extraCitaten.citaat: going to be bombarding out every turn

lessen.titel: Aim Organ Guns at infantry and lightly armoured targets
lessen.tekst: He considers infantry and other lightly armoured targets the best role for Organ Gun shooting.
lessen.waarom: He says targets without much of a save struggle against its volume of fire, which can reach twenty shots in a turn.

bronnen.citaat: the best role for these is going to be shooting at infantry

extraCitaten.citaat: anything that's lightly armored

lessen.titel: Avoid Organ Gun targets that stack shooting penalties
lessen.tekst: Do not aim Organ Guns at units imposing minus one or minus two to hit. If possible, choose targets that leave the gun hitting on fives or better, with an Engineer's rerolls of ones.
lessen.waarom: He says the Ballistic Skill 3 crew already hits on fives at long range, so additional penalties make the gun struggle.
lessen.voorbeeld: Against Wood Elves, he suggests shooting the Sisters or another target without shooting penalties.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He notes that an Engineer cannot provide both a misfire reroll and rerolls of ones at the same time.

bronnen.citaat: minus one to hit or minus two to hit don't shoot these at them

extraCitaten.citaat: these really struggle once you start to stack the negatives to hit on them

lessen.titel: Deploy Organ Guns between units to soften approaching enemies
lessen.tekst: Place an Organ Gun centrally between two units. Use its range to shoot approaching enemies for two or three turns and whittle down what will fight your combat troops.
lessen.waarom: He wants the gun firing each turn as the opponent approaches, doing as much damage as possible before the enemy reaches his combat line.

bronnen.citaat: deploy an organ gun would be in the middle of two units

extraCitaten.citaat: normally you're going to have at least two to three turns of shooting

lessen.titel: Start artillery behind woods and pivot into a firing position
lessen.tekst: Start a war machine behind a wood without touching it, then pivot into the wood on your turn to see out. He uses this to stay unseen if the opponent goes first while preparing his own shooting.
lessen.waarom: He also values woods that slow an enemy charge and force the lower charge die, potentially buying another shooting turn; dangerous woods can add dangerous terrain tests.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says you cannot pivot back into hiding after shooting. Hiding with a pivot on a later turn means choosing not to shoot, and the charge protection depends on the terrain rules in use.

bronnen.citaat: you can start the game positioned behind the wood not touching

extraCitaten.citaat: when the game starts in your turn you can then pivot into the wood
the enemy can't see you in their turn if they go first

lessen.titel: Use cannons against Evasive units and stacked hit penalties
lessen.tekst: Use cannons against units relying on Evasive or multiple shooting hit penalties. He recommends targeting a point on the ground in front of an Evasive unit rather than the unit itself.
lessen.waarom: He values targeting a ground point instead of the unit and says cannonballs bypass the hit penalties protecting these targets.
lessen.voorbeeld: He highlights shooting through a conveniently lined-up unit of Pegasus Knights, dealing D3 damage to each model wounded.

bronnen.citaat: shoot units that either have evade

extraCitaten.citaat: you only target a point on the ground in front of them

lessen.titel: Castle in a corner against Bretonnian flyers
lessen.tekst: Against Bretonnia, build a corner castle anchored on terrain, with ranged units at the front. Leave no opening for Pegasus Knights to jump behind it or come around its flanks.
lessen.waarom: He wants the knights to weather at least the first couple of turns of shooting before they can charge the defensive position.
lessen.voorbeeld: He suggests a corner with a hill or wood, or anchoring the force against a building.

bronnen.citaat: find a corner on the battlefield

extraCitaten.citaat: have your range units at the front

lessen.titel: Use plentiful Strength 4 shooting against Bretonnia
lessen.tekst: Use a high volume of Strength 4 shooting against Bretonnian knights rather than automatically favouring stronger shots.
lessen.waarom: He says Strength 4 avoids their improved ward save against stronger shooting while still wounding ordinary knights on threes and Pegasus Knights on fours.
lessen.voorbeeld: He has personally found handguns effective, especially with Burlok Damminson or in an Expeditionary Force that reduces the shooting penalties he worries about.

bronnen.citaat: for that shooting I would suggest lots of strength four

lessen.titel: Fill woods with Rangers to deny The Green Knight
lessen.tekst: Spread skirmishing Rangers around and through a backfield wood so The Green Knight has no room to appear there.
lessen.waarom: He says The Green Knight cannot emerge from that wood if there is no space for him to fit.

bronnen.citaat: have a unit of Rangers and create a circle and fill up the wood

extraCitaten.citaat: as long as he can't fit he can't pop out of that wood

lessen.titel: Prepare magical weapons for The Green Knight
lessen.tekst: Give unit champions magical weapons to help fight The Green Knight. For a backline Anvil of Doom, he suggests a simple Rune of Cleaving.
lessen.waarom: He expects The Green Knight to seek an apparently easy target such as the Anvil of Doom rather than a large Dwarf block.

bronnen.citaat: an offensive way to play against Green Knight would be by taking magical weapons

extraCitaten.citaat: giving the Anvil a simple Rune of cleaving can really help deal with him

lessen.titel: Take Rune of Hesitation against Bretonnian lances
lessen.tekst: Use Rune of Hesitation on a combat block to blunt Bretonnian lance charges, then try to win on combat resolution and pursue into a grind.
lessen.waarom: He says it leaves ordinary knights charging at Strength 3 and Pegasus Knights at Strength 4, without armour piercing from those attacks. He wants to trap Bretonnia in the prolonged combat it does not want.

bronnen.citaat: you can also capitalize on this by taking the Rune of hesitation

extraCitaten.citaat: get them stuck in a grind which is exactly where batonette doesn't want to be

lessen.titel: Use Rune of Preservation to challenge Bretonnian lords
lessen.tekst: Take Rune of Preservation on a character intended to challenge a Duke or Baron. Try to contain the enemy character's damage and win through the unit's combat resolution.
lessen.waarom: He presents Preservation as an answer to their Killing Blow and hopes the challenged character will inflict few wounds.
lessen.wanneerNiet: His plan depends on the Duke or Baron accepting the challenge, and he describes the outcome as a hope rather than a certainty.

bronnen.citaat: something we can do to counter this is by taking the Rune of preservation

extraCitaten.citaat: hopefully that Duke or Baron will accept

lessen.titel: Hide Grudge Throwers to bombard Bretonnian Bombards
lessen.tekst: Use Grudge Throwers out of enemy cannon sight to attack Bretonnian Bombards. He suggests hiding them behind buildings or far enough behind woods that a bounce cannot reach them.
lessen.waarom: He wants to destroy the Bombards without exposing his own artillery, gaining a points lead that makes the knights come to him.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He warns that woods alone may not protect them: an enemy cannon can aim just before the wood and bounce through it.

bronnen.citaat: these are absolutely amazing to deal with the bombard

extraCitaten.citaat: you can hide them behind buildings

lessen.titel: Put Irondrakes up front against Bretonnian charges
lessen.tekst: Put Irondrakes at the front so Bretonnian knights have to endure their Stand and Shoot before fighting.
lessen.waarom: He rates their volume of Strength 5 shots, particularly with the grenade, despite the enemy's improved ward save. He also points to lucky sixes getting through armour.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes an opponent using a Vanguard banner to attempt a first-turn charge and overcommitting into a large volume of shooting.
lessen.wanneerNiet: The Stand and Shoot plan assumes the enemy is not using the banner that prevents it.

bronnen.citaat: having your iron Dres up front

extraCitaten.citaat: the amount of shots that you can do especially with the grenade is absolutely amazing

lessen.titel: Keep clatter-gun Gyrocopters beyond Pegasus Knight charges
lessen.tekst: If Irondrakes are unavailable, he strongly suggests multiple Gyrocopters in an Expeditionary Force. Shoot Pegasus Knights with clatter guns while staying just outside their charge range.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says to deal with the Bombards before sending Gyrocopters out, because a good firing line can let them destroy one or two a turn.

bronnen.citaat: stay just out of charge range of those Pegasus Knights

lessen.titel: Fly steam guns outside the knights' charge arcs
lessen.tekst: Fly steam-gun Gyrocopters close to Mounted Knights of the Realm while remaining outside their charge arc, then shoot them.
lessen.waarom: He says a steam gun can take out an entire unit of those knights.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says to remove the Bombards before sending the Gyrocopters out.

bronnen.citaat: flying right up out of Arc of those Knights of the realm

lessen.titel: Use a rapid Dwarf advance into Mortuary Cult
lessen.tekst: Use Drilled, marching column and the Anvil's second move as part of a rapid advance into Mortuary Cult. He also recommends the Vanguard banner to help set up a charge on the following turn.
lessen.waarom: He says a stationary Dwarf army will be shot and blasted off the table by the Mortuary Cult gunline.
lessen.voorbeeld: He suggests using a semi-Death Star of about 20 to 25 Longbeards, Dwarf Warriors or Hammerers for this advance.

bronnen.citaat: the combination of drilled marching column

extraCitaten.citaat: also with the Vanguard Banner that really helps as well

lessen.titel: Take three Spellbreaking runes in the advancing unit
lessen.tekst: Put a Runesmith with three Runes of Spellbreaking in the combat unit advancing into Mortuary Cult. Stop Reserve Move, Column of Crystal and Mirage spells that would prevent it reaching combat.
lessen.waarom: He says those spells let targets leave the unit's charge arc or leave it stranded under shooting, making the Runesmith crucial to this plan.

bronnen.citaat: with three Runes of spell breaking

extraCitaten.citaat: the reserve move needs to get stopped

bronnen.citaat: I like to put three Runes of spell breaking on these

lessen.titel: Consider a King's leadership against Tomb Kings' Necromancy
lessen.tekst: Consider a King for Leadership 10 when facing Tomb Kings' leadership reduction and magical attacks.
lessen.waarom: He says the King's higher leadership gives a useful bonus while Necromancy lowers leadership and the enemy exploits those debuffs for damage.

bronnen.citaat: also a king is very helpful because of the leadership 10

lessen.titel: Aim the Dwarf rush at Ushabti rather than Skeletons
lessen.tekst: Choose a worthwhile target before making the rapid advance into Mortuary Cult. He recommends charging Ushabti rather than getting stuck in a large Skeleton block.
lessen.waarom: He wants the advancing unit to earn points; he says the Skeletons can hold it for several turns without yielding useful points.
lessen.voorbeeld: He compares an enemy line of Ushabti with a line of 50 Skeletons and favours the Ushabti.

bronnen.citaat: I personally would suggest going into the OB shabti

extraCitaten.citaat: if you get stuck into the skeletons you won't get any points that game

lessen.titel: Consider flaming runes on artillery against Tomb Kings
lessen.tekst: Consider Runes of Flaming on artillery when targeting susceptible Tomb Kings models.
lessen.waarom: He says flaming wounds can cause an additional wound on a four-plus against those targets.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes a lucky Grudge Thrower or cannon hit destroying a Casket of Souls, whose explosion could then kill nearby characters.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He names only certain susceptible targets: Chariots, Bone Dragons, Caskets of Souls and some characters. He says flaming attacks are often a disadvantage elsewhere because of extra saves against them.

bronnen.citaat: it's potentially worth having Runes of flaming onto those artillery pieces

lessen.titel: Use Strength 8 shooting against an Armour of Ages dragon
lessen.tekst: Against a Tomb Prince or Tomb King on a Bone Dragon with Armour of Ages, restrict your shooting at it to Strength 8 attacks. He suggests Grudge Throwers and cannons, ideally with flaming runes.
lessen.waarom: He says rerolling successful wounds makes shots that wound on fives or sixes wasteful, whereas rerolling a two-plus is much more likely to cause damage.

bronnen.citaat: shoot the dragon with only stuff that is strength eight

lessen.titel: Commit one main block against a Mortuary Cult gunline
lessen.tekst: Send one large unit forward to do the main fighting rather than overcommitting the army. He would advance one or two supporting units to absorb some fire, then withdraw those units in marching column out of shooting range.
lessen.waarom: He wants the character-bearing unit to earn points while the rest of the army preserves its own points.

bronnen.citaat: just send one big unit up to do the work

extraCitaten.citaat: reverse them out and get out of range

lessen.titel: Leave backfield defenders for Tomb Scorpions
lessen.tekst: Keep something able to fight Tomb Scorpions near your Anvil of Doom and artillery rather than leaving the backfield undefended.
lessen.waarom: He expects Scorpions to appear behind the army and try to kill those pieces.
lessen.voorbeeld: He suggests a Doomseeker or units withdrawn from the advance as possible defenders.

bronnen.citaat: make sure that you have something there that can actually deal with them

extraCitaten.citaat: protect them against those scorpions that are popping out to kill you

lessen.titel: Hunt Reserve Move archers with Gyrocopters
lessen.tekst: Use Gyrocopters to go around terrain and destroy Tomb Kings archers that emerge to shoot and Reserve Move back into hiding.
lessen.waarom: He says these archers chip wounds off units and can later charge the rear of Dwarfs stuck fighting Skeletons.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes archers hiding behind buildings, coming out to shoot and then moving back.

bronnen.citaat: having gyrocopters that can go around and kill the reserve moving archers

lessen.titel: Engage Tomb Kings priests to stop Arise
lessen.tekst: With enough Gyrocopters in an Expeditionary Force, consider flying over the enemy lines to engage the priests and prevent Arise.
lessen.waarom: He says priests cannot use Arise while locked in combat, offering a way to interrupt the return of killed models.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He calls this risky and says to attempt it only if you think you can get away with it.

bronnen.citaat: engaging those priests as they can't do it when they're locked in combat

extraCitaten.citaat: jumping over their lines and then engaging with the priests

lessen.titel: Use Irondrakes against Tomb Kings chariot armies
lessen.tekst: Consider a couple of Irondrake units against a Tomb Kings army with many Chariots. Use their shooting and Stand and Shoot, including the grenade, to damage the approaching units.
lessen.waarom: He says their Strength 5 wounds these Chariots on threes and their flaming damage causes extra wounds through Dry as Dust. He also highlights Quick Shot when the enemy gets close.

bronnen.citaat: can deal with lots and lots of Chariots

extraCitaten.citaat: any flaming damage into them is going to be doing extra wounds

lessen.titel: Consider combat-resolution units against a Necrosphinx
lessen.tekst: Consider sending combat-resolution units into a Necrosphinx, surviving its attacks and trying to make it crumble.
lessen.waarom: He thinks it is not particularly strong in combat, while the artillery may already be busy with the Bone Dragon, Caskets of Souls or Screaming Skull Catapults.

bronnen.citaat: sending combat res units into the necro Spinx to try and combat res it out

lessen.titel: Keep Dwarfs over five inches from the back edge
lessen.tekst: Against Screaming Skull Catapults, keep Dwarf units more than five inches from your back board edge. He particularly warns about a pair trying to remove units with their first-turn shooting.
lessen.waarom: He says a wound can force Fall Back in Good Order and cites Resolute's minus one to flee rolls when explaining the five-inch margin.

bronnen.citaat: make sure that you're over 5 in away from the back of the board

lessen.titel: Boost Banshee reach with Spectral Steed and two Mortis Engines
lessen.tekst: Cast Spectral Steed on a Tomb Banshee positioned beside two Mortis Engines to extend her Wailing Dirge threat. He describes the combination as giving her a 12-inch flying move and a 20-inch scream threat.
lessen.waarom: He says the threat can make opponents reconsider where they place key units, helping him dictate the pace and protect his own assets.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He qualifies his claim of reaching almost any unit from turn two onwards against the most defensive army lists.

bronnen.citaat: spectral Steed on the tomb banshe boosts her movement to 10 in

extraCitaten.citaat: she's now flying 12 in and therefore has a 20 in threat

lessen.titel: Pair Mortis Engines with high-level casters for scream support
lessen.tekst: Consider two Mortis Engines ridden by high-level casters as the magical core of a Wailing Dirge army. Use them to help secure the spell combinations that support the screams.
lessen.waarom: He says their nearby casting bonuses stack, producing what he considers an almost unstoppable magic core.

bronnen.citaat: two of these bad boys being ridden by high level casters

extraCitaten.citaat: ensure you get the spell combinations off that make whaling durge so powerful

lessen.titel: Combine Spiritual Vortex and Spirit Leech before screaming
lessen.tekst: Combine Spiritual Vortex and Spirit Leech on the intended Wailing Dirge target when you can get both spells off. Use the combined Leadership reductions and loss of Inspiring Presence to make the screams more damaging.
lessen.waarom: He says even very resilient units can start losing wounds quickly to a couple of screams, making expensive cavalry and monsters reluctant to approach.

bronnen.citaat: if you're able to get both of these spells off

extraCitaten.citaat: to even just a couple of Screams

lessen.titel: Scream away screens, then Reserve Move through the gap
lessen.tekst: Use Hellish Vigor offensively on a Terrorgheist: advance, clear a screen with Wailing Dirge, then Reserve Move into the gap you created.
lessen.waarom: He says this avoids the screen holding the Terrorgheist up for a turn and puts pressure on an area the opponent thought was safe.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes clearing skirmishers screening enemy war machines and moving into the resulting gap.

bronnen.citaat: Reserve move into the Gap that you've created

extraCitaten.citaat: using the Wailing durge to clear maybe a screen of skirmishes

lessen.titel: Pick out lone wizards and BSBs with Wailing Dirge
lessen.tekst: Look for opportunities to target lone wizards or supporting battle standard bearers behind enemy lines with Wailing Dirge. He is keen to try exploiting its exemption from the usual lone-character targeting restrictions.
lessen.waarom: He says removing a hidden support character can cause unexpected disruption; he specifically highlights a BSB enabling rerolls of Terror and Fear tests.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He stresses that line of sight is still required and that picking out targets behind other units needs practice.

bronnen.citaat: ignores the usual rules for targeting lone characters meaning you can pick out

extraCitaten.citaat: or even choose to try and take down the buffing battle standard Bearer

lessen.titel: Pin expensive elites with Zombies and scream them down
lessen.tekst: Tie up an expensive elite enemy unit with a horde of Zombies, then keep using Wailing Dirge against it while it is pinned in combat.
lessen.waarom: He points out that Wailing Dirge can target units in combat, allowing repeated screams to inflict the wounds that finish the target.

bronnen.citaat: you can just pin them and then just scream and scream and scream

lessen.titel: Use Wailing Dirge to free an engaged Mortis Engine
lessen.tekst: If a Mortis Engine becomes bogged down in combat, use its Wailing Dirge against the enemy it is fighting to try to get it out.
lessen.waarom: He says Wailing Dirge can be used against the combat the screaming model is itself in.
lessen.voorbeeld: He describes an enemy overrunning into a Mortis Engine after the unit in front crumbled away.

bronnen.citaat: just scream your way out of combat

lessen.titel: Consider six screamers to build around Wailing Dirge
lessen.tekst: To make Wailing Dirge a central part of the army, consider two Mortis Engines, two Tomb Banshees and two Terrorgheists.
lessen.waarom: He thinks this combination can produce surprisingly high damage in the right situations.

bronnen.citaat: two mortors engines in it two banshees and two terrorists

extraCitaten.citaat: the sheer damage output it can bring to bear in the right

lessen.titel: Include control to buy Wood Elves time
lessen.tekst: Include an element of control to slow the opponent and create space for favourable strikes, rather than simply trading units.
lessen.waarom: He says Wood Elves usually need to buy time to win and find an advantage before striking.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He makes an exception for Wild Hunt, which can run straight at the opponent.

bronnen.citaat: you need an element of control in your faction some way or the other

extraCitaten.citaat: You can't just kind of trade as a wood elf player.

lessen.titel: Try a level-four Spellweaver on a Warhawk
lessen.tekst: He highly recommends a level-four Spellweaver on a Warhawk with Heartwood Pendant and Oaken Stave for battlefield control and magic defence. He prefers Lore of the Wilds through the pendant, but also considers Battle Magic or Elementalism viable alternatives; Ruby Ring is optional.
lessen.waarom: He values the combination of Evasive, flight and skirmishing for safe positioning, and Oaken Stave for defending against key enemy spells.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He says its magic defence will not match armies with exceptional casting bonuses, although it can compete with an ordinary level-four wizard.

bronnen.citaat: a spellw weaver level four on a warhawk.

extraCitaten.citaat: Ruby ring is probably optional but I wouldn't go home without the rest.
against your run-of-the-mill level four who just gets plus two

lessen.titel: Use Tree Singing to extend a defensive forest
lessen.tekst: With the mobile Warhawk wizard, consider Tree Singing to extend an existing forest in your deployment area and block line of sight. Place it outside the opponent's dispel range when possible.
lessen.waarom: He says the wizard's mobility helps it reach the needed position safely, and that Tree Singing can have an enormous effect when the opponent fails to dispel it.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He acknowledges that the opponent will often dispel Tree Singing.

bronnen.citaat: cast tree singing to create an extra long forest attached to another forest

extraCitaten.citaat: to block line of sight.

lessen.titel: Consider a lesser wizard with Lore Familiar
lessen.tekst: Consider accompanying the Warhawk control wizard with a lesser wizard carrying Lore Familiar to secure the spells you want.
lessen.waarom: He points out that the Warhawk build does not have Lore Familiar.

bronnen.citaat: a lesser wizard that has law familiar to get the spells you want.

lessen.titel: Prefer ten or twenty Glade Guard
lessen.tekst: He prefers building Glade Guard into units of ten or twenty rather than leaving the compulsory Grand Army unit at five.
lessen.waarom: He describes Glade Guard as damage dealers rather than merely a five-model roadblock, and notes that they also score.

bronnen.citaat: I think they're actually best placed when you have 10 of them or 20

extraCitaten.citaat: Glade Guard is your damage dealer.

lessen.titel: Keep Deepwood Scouts around ten models
lessen.tekst: He thinks ten models is the sweet spot for Deepwood Scouts, rather than building them like the larger Glade Guard units.
lessen.waarom: He gives them a distraction role and says opponents often dislike chasing ten elves.

bronnen.citaat: I think you only really want to take 10

lessen.titel: Give damage-dealing Glade Guard Arcane Bodkins
lessen.tekst: He recommends Arcane Bodkins for Glade Guard used as damage dealers.

bronnen.citaat: Gladeguard best off taking Arcane Bodguns because they're a damage dealer with this unit.

lessen.tekst: He thinks Trueflight Arrows are a slightly better fit for Deepwood Scouts that move and shoot while distracting the opponent.

bronnen.citaat: Deepwood scouts true flight arrows uh is a little bit better

extraCitaten.citaat: you are usually moving and shooting and their main role isn't to deal damage

lessen.titel: Keep Glade Guard distant and withdraw off the hill
lessen.tekst: Keep Glade Guard as far away as possible and stationary while shooting. When the enemy gets close enough, drop off the hill to make reaching them take another turn.
lessen.waarom: He warns that pushing Glade Guard forward like Evasive Deepwood Scouts leaves them vulnerable to being destroyed, particularly by Fireball.

bronnen.citaat: Your glade guard will often be as far away as possible

extraCitaten.citaat: Drop off the hill when they get close enough

lessen.titel: Use Deepwood Scouts to waste an opponent's turns
lessen.tekst: Use Deepwood Scouts as mobile distractions, repeatedly moving and shooting while making the opponent chase them. He suggests hiding them in a forest and using Evasive to leave it.
lessen.waarom: He says their role is distraction rather than dealing substantial damage, and opponents often do not want to chase ten elves.

bronnen.citaat: Hide them in a forest, evasive, out of the forest,

extraCitaten.citaat: waste an opponent's turn, make them chase you

lessen.titel: Keep Glade Riders and Warhawk Riders out of combat
lessen.tekst: Do not treat Glade Riders' cavalry spears as a reason to put them into combat. He gives the same warning for Warhawk Riders.
lessen.waarom: He says Wood Elf units have tightly defined roles and are punished when used outside those roles.

bronnen.citaat: having them in condat is like a bonus cuz they have cav spears

just can't do it.

lessen.titel: Place Woodland Ambush to create a sheltered corridor
lessen.tekst: Consider placing Woodland Ambush between a hill and impassable terrain to create a sheltered corridor behind them. In his experience, the extra forest generally works best in or just outside your deployment zone.
lessen.waarom: He uses this space to hide units, manoeuvre towards the enemy backline and shelter units that may need to Evade into it.

bronnen.citaat: a hill into a forest into impossible terrain, creating an entire corridor

extraCitaten.citaat: hide in, run around, get in your opponent's backline.

lessen.titel: Generally seek the second turn with Wood Elves
lessen.tekst: He generally prefers going second with Wood Elves, alongside a defensive, concealed deployment.
lessen.waarom: He describes Wood Elves as a reactive army: letting the opponent start moving gives them opportunities to respond and pick off targets.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He excludes Wild Hunt, which he considers almost the opposite of ordinary Wood Elves.

bronnen.citaat: I think generally you're looking to go second with wood elves
wood elves probably want to go second

lessen.titel: Move Wood Elves into the space you clear
lessen.tekst: When you clear one side of the board, move into that open ground rather than remaining stationary. Keep shifting towards the opponent's deployment zone as the enemy chases you.
lessen.waarom: He says punching through and relocating forces the opponent to split its forces, making it harder to kill the whole Wood Elf army.

bronnen.citaat: When you clear space, taking open ground is what it's all about.

extraCitaten.citaat: you're pushing to your opponent's deployment zone as they chase around you.

bronnen.citaat: Move into the space they occupied.

lessen.titel: Try a Scar-Veteran on a Carnosaur competitively
lessen.tekst: For competitive Lizardmen, he recommends trying a Saurus Scar-Veteran on a Carnosaur if you have not played that option much.
lessen.waarom: He rates the Carnosaur as an efficient choice: for about 300 points it brings Strength 7, Toughness 6, numerous attacks, Swiftstride and Terror, and can also do useful work against other monsters.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He is unsure it can win the game for you in the way a dragon can.

bronnen.citaat: a scar veteran version of the carnosur, then I would go for that for sure.

lessen.titel: Keep a Slann despite its cost
lessen.tekst: He recommends embracing the Slann Mage-Priest and making the most of it rather than leaving it out. He sees particular versatility in the Renegades version.
lessen.waarom: He thinks giving up the Slann sacrifices too much. He finds it capable of staying alive, preserving a substantial investment in points.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He acknowledges that it is overcosted and does not do much.

bronnen.citaat: you just got to embrace the slan.

extraCitaten.citaat: definitely capable of keeping alive

lessen.titel: Consider a Cold One Oldblood without a Slann
lessen.tekst: If skipping the Slann Mage-Priest or spending those points on a combat character, he thinks a Saurus Oldblood on a Cold One might be a worthwhile option.
lessen.waarom: He considers its statistics very good for what you get and values the all-round charge options available to Lizardmen characters.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He finds the Oldblood harder to make work because the faction's magic items are poor.

bronnen.citaat: old blood on a cold one might actually be not that bad

lessen.titel: Choose a Vanguard or Scout screening package
lessen.tekst: At 2,000 points, he suggests a Vanguard screen using Jungle Swarms and two units of Skink Skirmishers. Alternatively, use Chameleon Skinks and two units of Skink Skirmishers as Scouts.
lessen.waarom: He says these screeners let the army use movement tricks and potentially shooting in the early game.

bronnen.citaat: you can toggle between having the vanguard screen.

extraCitaten.citaat: Or you can run chameleon skinks and two units of normal skinks as scouts.

lessen.titel: Try blocking undead reinforcements with a Reserve Move
lessen.tekst: Consider a two-turn attempt against Grave Guard: shoot away enough models to create space, then Reserve Move a unit one inch behind them to obstruct raising before attacking next turn. Ideally leave part of a second rank; if only one rank remains, his proposal also requires blocking one side to prevent sideways raising.
lessen.waarom: Under his proposed rules interpretation, a unit with multiple ranks cannot widen when raising, and new models cannot be added within one inch of the blocking enemy. He argues that a single remaining rank cannot expand sideways if one side is blocked because its command group must remain central. The undead player's command subphase passes before the blocker can be removed, leaving the depleted unit available for a killing attack next turn.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He presents this as a thought experiment requiring several things to line up, and says the sideways-raising interpretation needs an FAQ. There must be space for the blocker; larger bases need larger gaps. A required Reserve Move spell might fail, the blocker may die next turn, and enemy chaff may prevent the finishing attack.

lessen.titel: Use regular knights to buy artillery more time
lessen.tekst: For Empire, consider regular knights to pressure the opponent into manoeuvring to face the cavalry. Use that distraction to give your artillery more time to damage enemy units.
lessen.waarom: He says that an opponent worrying about the cavalry gives Empire artillery more time to fire. He stresses that objective points offer little help if the army is destroyed.

bronnen.citaat: that just gives our artillery more time

extraCitaten.citaat: we're probably using regular knights for this.

lessen.titel: Try six Silver Helms with full command and Ring of Fury
lessen.tekst: He endorses six Silver Helms with full command and the Ring of Fury, a setup he intends to keep running.
lessen.waarom: He says the setup has worked really well for him, including the standard bearer he had considered dropping.

bronnen.citaat: Six models with the ring of fury, and it's been working out

extraCitaten.citaat: really well for me. So, I'm very pleased to keep running it.

lessen.titel: Place one Drilled cavalry model behind terrain for cover
lessen.tekst: With Drilled heavy cavalry, he recommends placing one model behind terrain to gain cover against shooting.
lessen.waarom: He says this placement gives the unit a minus-one shooting modifier from cover regardless of the firing direction.
lessen.voorbeeld: He points to the opposing Chosen Chaos Knights, with one model just behind terrain, as the setup to copy.
lessen.wanneerNiet: He notes that Sisters of Avelorn ignore cover, so it would not help against their shooting.

bronnen.citaat: One model is just behind the terrain

extraCitaten.citaat: they ignore cover, but it's just a good

lessen.titel: Face your dragon forward to discourage an aggressive advance
lessen.tekst: In the deployment he reviews, he would point the dragon further forwards to make the opponent play more defensively.
lessen.waarom: He says the dragon could still have stayed near Arcane Urgency and wheeled right if needed.
lessen.voorbeeld: He believes his dragon's actual facing helped Adam advance more aggressively than he had expected.

bronnen.citaat: would have made Adam have to be more defensive.

extraCitaten.citaat: I could always just wheel over to the right if needs be.

lessen.titel: Surround Drilled Chosen Knights on all four sides
lessen.tekst: To pin Chosen Chaos Knights with Drilled and Arcane Urgency for a dragon attack, use fast units to box them in on all four sides.
lessen.waarom: He says Drilled and Arcane Urgency make the knights difficult to pin down, so he needs to close off all four sides to secure the target for his dragon.
lessen.voorbeeld: He positioned his Griffon so that the knights' base would clip it when trying to wheel out. He and Adam agreed the knights were trapped, and they charged the Griffon.

bronnen.citaat: I have to pin him in on all four sides

extraCitaten.citaat: I've used the fact that I've got very fast moving units here to pin in

lessen.titel: Avoid sending a champion into your dragon's next challenge
lessen.tekst: Before issuing a challenge, consider whether declining it will move the enemy champion into the rank your dragon will charge next turn. In his position, he should have avoided challenging with the Noble and accepted one more attack instead.
lessen.waarom: He found that the champion moved to the rear could then accept the dragon's challenge, restricting the dragon's contribution to the next fight.
lessen.voorbeeld: His Noble challenged the Chosen Chaos Knights. Adam declined and moved the champion to the rear, where the dragon was positioned to attack next turn.

bronnen.citaat: I should not have challenged with the noble and just taken one more attack.

extraCitaten.citaat: the dragon is locked in a challenge

lessen.titel: Do not extend enemy retreats through your supporting units
lessen.tekst: When moving support around an enemy combat, avoid creating a chain of friendly units that carries the retreating enemy out of reach. Check where that retreat will leave it before placing the support.
lessen.waarom: He found that his placement let the surviving knights escape and tie up his wizard, costing him magic defence and leaving roughly 400 points trapped in combat.
lessen.voorbeeld: The Chosen Chaos Knights retreated through his Griffon, a Silver Helms unit he says he should not have moved there, and his Reavers. The last two knights then charged the Reavers and Archmage.

bronnen.citaat: through this unit of silver helms which I shouldn't have moved to here

extraCitaten.citaat: having this 400 points tied up and all my magic defense gone is absolutely backbreaking.

lessen.titel: Identify which unit will determine the enemy's retreat direction
lessen.tekst: When setting up charges, identify the highest Unit Strength and which unit the enemy will run away from. Allow for the opponent killing models to change which of your units has the highest Unit Strength.
lessen.voorbeeld: His dragon had the highest Unit Strength, so the Chosen Chaos Knights retreated away from it through three of his other units.

bronnen.citaat: just think about what's the highest unit strength

extraCitaten.citaat: your opponent can tweak that by killing models in certain units
